_comment: Phase 805 nightly-benchmark regression baseline. Seeded from docs/performance/benchmarks.md's already-published, git-SHA-tagged 'end-to-end bridge macro (docker-proxy)' historical row -- the same code path the nightly workflow measures (bench-macro's bridge port, not bench-hostnative's host-networking path). Update this file only when a deliberate, reviewed capacity change lands (e.g. a real perf improvement) -- not automatically. See docs/runbooks/nightly_benchmark_regression.md for the update procedure.

source.method: make bench-macro (bridge port via docker-proxy, ja4p test benchmark --duration 30)

throughput_cps.comment: Regression = throughput drops more than --gate percent below this value.

p95_latency_ms.comment: Regression = p95 latency rises more than --gate percent above this value.

p99_latency_ms.comment: No historical baseline published yet -- trended in Grafana, not gated, until enough nightly runs accumulate real p99 history.

error_rate_gate.comment: Every published historical row measured 0 errors. Tolerate a small flake margin (1%) rather than gating on strictly zero, to avoid a single transient connection reset failing the whole nightly run.
